stories.summary: Teva told the Post it remains committed to working constructively with healthcare professionals across Ireland and to supporting patients through the "consistent supply of high-quality medicines."

stories.headline: ANC election losses could weaken South Africa's anti-Israel stance
stories.summary: The ANC’s vote share fell to about 31% in municipal elections, and a former DA official says coalition partners could gradually push for a more pragmatic approach to Israel.

stories.headline: Nvidia opens probe after report of CEO Huang's relationship with alleged Chinese spy
stories.summary: Huang said in a message to employees: "I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry."

stories.headline: Blinken: I warned Netanyahu Israel could lose young Republicans and evangelicals
stories.summary: Speaking at the Jewish Federations of North America’s General Assembly in Washington, Blinken recalled a conversation with Netanyahu in the spring of 2024 about the political consequences of the war.

stories.headline: 'Iranian demands are outrageous,' Rubio says as talks fail to make progress
stories.summary: Ahead of a G7 meeting in France, Rubio said Iran talks have made no progress, calling Tehran's demands "unacceptable" and warning that the US could respond to threats against its forces.

stories.headline: Rep. Fine to 'Post': I will not endorse Vance in 2028, blaming Jews for GOP losses inexcusable
stories.summary: Republican Congressman Randy Fine of Florida accused Vice President JD Vance of betraying Trump and scapegoating Israel and American Jews for the Republican Party’s crushing midterm defeat.

stories.headline: Eisenkot, Netanyahu have 'very similar views,' Trump says, suggests both would support him
stories.summary: "I guess he said very nice things about me. He says he loves Trump, but I don’t know. I haven’t seen what’s happening,” the president added, referring to Eisenkot.

stories.headline: Biden says cancer treatment is slowing him down, plans fewer appearances for upcoming memoir
stories.summary: “Some days are better than others. It hasn’t stopped me. But sometimes it slows me down,” Biden wrote. “Unfortunately, I won’t be able to do as many conversations about my book as I’d hoped.”

stories.headline: 'You are a coward': Danon confronts Iranian UN representative in heated confrontation
stories.summary: "You are a coward, and your leaders are cowards hiding underground," Danon told Iran's UN representative, warning that Tehran would face consequences for its support of terrorism.

stories.headline: Trump cites dislike of Israel as key factor in GOP midterm losses alongside war with Iran
stories.summary: Asked to explain the defeat, Trump insisted that his personal popularity remained strong and suggested that Republican candidates had failed to translate his support into votes.

stories.headline: Tel Aviv to impose fines of up to NIS 1,000 on drivers for excessive honking
stories.summary: The system will initially be installed at 11 locations across the city, including the intersection of Bograshov and Tchernichovsky streets and the area around Rabin Square

stories.headline: Official Data Shows 450,000 Russians Killed in War, Death Rate Accelerating – Rosstat Leaks
stories.summary: The war in Ukraine has become the fourth most common cause of death in Russia since 2022, according to official statistics released by hackers.
